title: Fixed Twin-trunk Bucket Elevator
description: One newly authored complete fixed industrial-style grain bucket-elevator appearance: a continuous thick closed loop casing forms two narrow vertical hollow trunks and rounded upper and lower return hoods around a real open middle gap. One front inspection opening exposes a complete internal closed belt and actual thick open scoops; the rest remains enclosed. A low left intake and high right downward outlet are full hollow ducts communicating through actual casing ports. Four full grounded feet, two pulley drums, whole axles and external bearing bridges support the single assembly. No old chain-lift or roller-conveyor meshes imported. Not an exposed timber irrigation chain lift merely resized: enclosing return chambers, double hollow trunks, real inspection and side transfer openings are new complete geometry. One whole model, zero scenes. Fixed appearance only; no conveying, elevation, throughput, load, seal, power, maintenance access, fabrication or safety claim.
